_readme: PERSONAS — known profiles on the platform that anyone can sign in as, on any browser.
To add one: 1) sign in on any storefront with the persona's email and build its history (buy, browse, set a trip);
2) open the profile in the panel (User Profiles → search the email) and copy the UUID identifier — the value next to 'UUID Identifier', not the profile id in the URL;
3) add an entry below: key (slug), name (what it demonstrates), description (one line), email, uuid, profile (fields to sign in with);
4) commit and push. Entries whose uuid is missing or still says PASTE are hidden from visitors.
Or: on the account page, 'Save current profile as a persona' then 'Copy my personas as JSON' and paste the entry here.

name: Shai — Gold member
description: The estate's main demo profile: Gold tier, purchase history seeded, browse-abandonment and back-in-stock events on the profile. Use for any signed-in beat.
